body: Continuing the fatbaby data-ingestion audit after S170-07: checked every prwatch-body consumer (buyback-watcher, eps-processor clean; earnings-calendar had 4 stale low-volume records, not worth chasing; dividend-watcher was 70% contaminated -- 14 of 20 live records, including a fabricated 'raise' signal already written to entity-graph). Extracted the litigation-alert filter into a new shared internal/prspam package, refactored guidance-watcher onto it, wired into dividend-watcher. Regenerated var/dividends/dividends.ndjson (20 -> 7 records). Rebuilt and restarted fatbaby-dividend-watcher.service. New follow-up found, not fixed this pass: a real Target press release is still misclassified as a dividend raise (different root cause, dividend.Classify's own false-positive rate, not spam). Commits 14c2930, c6a5fc2.
title: dividend-watcher had the same litigation-alert spam bug as guidance-watcher
